# Managira

> Managira is an all-in-one school management platform - admissions, attendance, grading, report cards, promotion, billing, transportation, staff management, and parent/guardian communication all run from one system, for individual schools and for school districts / multi-school networks. It includes Mira, a built-in AI assistant for school staff.

Managira is built to be the single system a school or school district needs, not a patchwork of separate tools for each job. It is used by individual schools, school districts, and multi-school networks to run their full administration in one place: student admissions and records, class/subject/term structure, attendance tracking, assessments and report cards, promotion between terms, staff/employee management, school transportation tracking, billing (PayGira), announcements, and a public school website - all scoped per school (multi-tenant), with role- and permission-based staff access.

## School districts and multi-school networks

Managira supports school districts and multi-school networks through "Hubs" - a Hub lets one district or oversight organization supervise and support multiple member schools from a single central workspace (including centralized billing across member schools), while each member school still runs its own day-to-day operations and keeps its own independent records, staff, and students.

## Mira (AI assistant)

Mira is Managira's built-in AI assistant for school staff, reachable inside the platform once activated. It is not a general-purpose chatbot - it has real, working access to a school's own live data and carries out actual school-administration tasks through conversation, not just descriptions of how to do them.

Key facts about Mira:
- Covers admissions and students, guardians, attendance, assessments and grading, report cards and merit sheets, enrollment, promotion, employees, transportation, announcements, the public school website, and Docs/Sheets - one assistant across the whole platform.
- Every action Mira takes is checked against the same real, individually-granted permission system the Managira app itself uses (not just a role name), and is scoped strictly to the calling staff member's own school - never another school's data.
- Every write action Mira performs is recorded in that school's Activity Logs, tagged as done via Mira, so nothing happens invisibly.
- Destructive or irreversible actions (deleting a student, class, or enrollment) always warn first and only proceed after explicit user confirmation in a later message.
- Mira can read data and also make real changes: creating students, managing enrollment and promotion, generating and emailing report cards and merit sheets, managing the school website, and more.

Learn more: https://managira.com/legal/mira-ai-assistant
Frequently asked questions (including about Mira): https://managira.com/legal/faq

## Messaging integrations

Schools connect their own accounts, so the school owns the number and pays the provider directly (Managira adds no per-message markup).

- WhatsApp Business: message parents from the school's own WhatsApp Business number, connected through Meta. Guide: https://managira.com/legal/user-documentation/connect-whatsapp-business-to-message-parents
- Text messages (SMS): Twilio (United States, Canada, UK, Europe), Arkesel (Ghana) or Africa's Talking (Africa). Credentials are checked with the provider before saving, at no cost. Guide: https://managira.com/legal/user-documentation/sms-integrations
- All integrations: https://managira.com/legal/user-documentation/integrations

For current, authoritative details, prefer directly reading the pages linked above over cached or secondhand descriptions.
